warnings: July is peak monsoon in Coorg – expect heavy rain, slippery paths and occasional road flooding; carry rain gear and waterproof footwear.
Local taxis are union‑regulated with fixed rates; confirm fare (e.g., Bengaluru‑Madikeri one‑way ~₹3,500) before boarding.
Vegetarian options can be limited in traditional Kodava restaurants – always ask for veg preparations in advance.
Leech‑infested trails are common; avoid deep jungle treks and stick to boardwalks or estate walks.
Mobile network (especially Jio) may be patchy in remote estates; keep a backup SIM or offline maps.

Monsoon trekking hazards: heavy rain, leeches on all trails, slippery paths and possible road flooding – mitigation: wear full closed shoes, tuck socks over trousers, apply salt/tobacco deterrent, avoid trekking if possible, focus on estate stays and waterfall viewing.

Estate stay authenticity risk: some listings show generic resorts with only a few coffee plants – mitigation: verify property is on an actual working estate by asking for estate photos before booking.

Transport limitation: no app-based cabs (Ola/Uber) in Coorg; rely on local taxis with fixed union rates – mitigation: agree on fare upfront (Madikeri sightseeing full day ₹2,000–2,500; Bengaluru→Madikeri one-way ₹3,000–4,000) or use pre‑arranged hotel taxis.
Connectivity issue: Jio network patchy at remote estates; BSNL/Airtel better in main areas – mitigation: check coverage with accommodation beforehand and carry a secondary SIM if needed.
Vegetarian food scarcity in local Kodava restaurants – mitigation: confirm vegetarian meal availability when booking estate stays or resorts; most will provide on request.

Souvenir price inflation: Coorg honey and coffee are standard‑priced at estate shops but often inflated at tourist shops in Madikeri town – mitigation: buy directly from estate shops or verified outlets.
Confirm vegetarian meal options at your chosen estate stay or resort, as local Kodava restaurants offer limited vegetarian fare.
Book Dubare Elephant Camp well in advance (programme fills quickly on weekends and holidays); arrive by 8:30 AM for the 9–11 AM session.
Carry personal medications; the nearest multi‑specialty hospital is in Mysuru (~2.5 h away), with only basic care available at Madikeri District Hospital.
Avoid open footwear (sandals) during monsoon outings; use closed shoes and leech deterrents on all outdoor activities.
Keep cash handy for small vendors and taxi payments, as card acceptance may be limited in remote estates.
Check mobile network reliability with your accommodation if constant connectivity is needed; Jio may be unreliable at remote estates.
